title: Top 2 longest queries per database
description: For each database_name return at most two longest queries and exactly three columns: database_name, query_id, duration_ms. Rank within each database by duration_ms DESC, then query_id ASC for ties. Use ROW_NUMBER(). Sort the final result by database_name ASC and preserve that rank order within each database.
starter_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT database_name, id AS query_id, duration_ms
    FROM query_stats
)
hints: ROW_NUMBER() must use PARTITION BY database_name.
After calculating rn, filter rn <= 2 in the outer query.
solution_explanation: The window function ranks queries independently inside each database, then the outer query keeps the first two.
